_meta.slot_formula: slot(advance N) = (advance_rng^(N+draws)(seedA) >> 16) % 10, draws=1 for grass/surf and 2 for a rod (the nibble check draws first)
_meta.note: all 5 methods; every method draws a flat 10-slot table, but the number of block-conditionals differs (grass 10, surf 3, rods 2). Block-conditionals fill top slots in order (PokeFinder Encounters4::getHGSSSafari). Surf/rod tables are emitted only for the 5 areas with water.
